_comment: The Grade 2 Science standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools and built by ../lesson-kit. Order here IS the lesson number. Ten lessons organised by the sub-strands of Cambridge Primary Science 0097 Stage 2 (44 objectives), NOT by the units of the 0846-aligned course under science/grade-2/data, so progress is written under l01..l10 - see THE UNIT PROBLEM in wire-progress.py. objectiveFloors are recorded at the measured value after each build and may rise, not fall.
subject: science
hubStrands: Models and diagrams; ask, predict, sort, use equipment, measure in non-standard units, look things up in a fact card, record in tables, spot patterns, and build block graphs.
How animals are alike and different; teeth and how to care for them; staying healthy and the signs of illness; how young animals change and take after their parents; habitats.
Natural and manufactured materials; properties, and testing for them; why a material is chosen for a job; changes that make a new material.
Forces change movement and shape, and nothing changes speed on its own; light sources and darkness; using electricity safely; cells, wires and lamps in a circuit.
Kinds of rock and where rock comes from; how people affect the environment; the Sun's path across the sky.
How thinking has changed, how everyday things work, who uses science at work, and how what we do affects the world.
